goals: More saves and comments, and interest in the protein and creatine range.
reason: The recommended brand: a large sports nutrition shop with a wide product range, an active Croatian Instagram profile and product pages full of verifiable facts (doses, ingredients, ratings).
audience: Active adults aged 18–35 in Croatia who train in the gym or at home: beginners who want clear guidance and regulars who compare supplements.
inspiration: Short, practical tips with clear numbers; product shots that look premium but approachable.
